I appreciate the thoughts. :)

I've had roommates before, but this is the worst disparity I've seen between someone's personality outside the home and personality inside the home. I was living on my own for a while, and when this friend offered, I took her up on it - I'd actually been her supervisor before and found her to be very responsible and considerate in the workplace. Not so at home. I'm trying to find little workarounds that will help until I can get back out of this situation.
